name: Freelance invoice ledger
audience: Freelancers and sole proprietors invoicing in rand.
summary: Track invoices, what has been paid, and what is still outstanding.
description: Each row is one invoice. Status must be Paid or Outstanding. The summary uses SUMIF so a paid invoice does not remain in the cash you are waiting for. A small expense list shows profit after costs.
benefits: Separate paid cash from invoices you have only sent
See profit after the costs of the work
Keep the client and invoice number on the same row
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
